messages:
emma: Heads-up — after the RBAC refactor rolled at 09:05 UTC some service accounts are getting 403s from the KMS proxy when using the client SDK. Anyone else seeing this?
raj: Yep, we're seeing a spike in decrypt failures. Started ~09:12 UTC. Audit log snippets show `missing permission: kms:decrypt` for role `svc-inference-worker`.
sophie: The policy split we shipped separated `kms` into finer perms (`kms:decrypt`, `kms:wrap_key`). Docs need a migration note.
mike: Quick workaround is to attach the legacy `kms:*` or the managed policy `redwood/kms-legacy` to affected roles, but that's not ideal.
emma: Error traces also show the SDK is sending an `x-access-assertion` header. KMS proxy expects `x-subject-assertion` after the refactor — looks like a header rename mismatch.
raj: I reproduced locally with curl: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "x-access-assertion: svc:inference" https://kms.redwood.internal/decrypt``` -> 403. Replace header name with `x-subject-assertion` -> 200.
sophie: I'll open a PR in the SDK to map the old header to the new one (backwards-compatible). We'll also add a warning on startup if `x-access-assertion` is used.
docs: I'll draft a short FAQ/migration note and include example policy snippets and a `rwdctl` simulate command. Which roles are affected?
emma: Affected: `svc-inference-worker`, `svc-batcher`, `svc-embedder`, plus some CI runners that call KMS for token encryption.
mike: Can we hotfix the KMS proxy to accept both header names for a short window? That would minimize outages while SDKs roll forward. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy started: kms-proxy v2.3.7-hotfix (ci-1234) — canary -> us-east-1
raj: Canary looks good. Error rate down from 14% -> 0.6% in the canary pool. Audit logs show `authorized:true` for the curl test.
emma: Good. Action items: (1) patch proxy to accept header alias (mike), (2) SDK PR to map/rename header and ship a minor release (sophie + mike), (3) docs FAQ + migration guide + sample IAM policies (docs), (4) audit all service roles for explicit `kms:decrypt` permission and avoid `kms:*` where unnecessary (raj). I'll file a follow-up incident ticket and tag infra.
security-bot: incident created: INC-2026-045 | RBAC-KMS-Header | severity=P2
emma: Thanks everyone. Please drop PR links and deploy IDs here when ready so I can close the incident. :zap:
